subject: Annual attack simulation — pricing, SOW items, and evidence handling
messages:
From: Ethan Ward <ethan.ward@redgatesec.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Revised SOW & pricing for annual attack simulation

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — per our discussion attached is RedGate's revised SOW (version 2) for Acme Health's annual attack simulation. Highlights:
- Full external black-box web app test + targeted authenticated coverage for two internal services.
- One full-day tabletop & two remediation check-ins.
- Deliverables: detailed findings report, prioritized remediation tracker, and short executive summary.

Price is $48,500 (line items in cost_breakdown.xlsx). We included a 10% loyalty discount given last year's engagement.

Two operational notes we flagged for you to confirm: evidence transfer (we can provide presigned S3 URLs encrypted at rest, or use a secure SCP/Aspera workflow) and PII redaction in the final report (we can ship a redacted summary first and the full report under an NDA with explicit handling steps).

Attaching: RedGates_SOW_v2.pdf, cost_breakdown.xlsx.

Can you confirm the preferred evidence transfer method and whether Acme needs an invoice/PO up front? If you want to move forward we can push DocuSign today.

Best,
Ethan

Ethan Ward
Principal Consultant | RedGate Security
[attachment: RedGates_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: cost_breakdown.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Ward <ethan.ward@redgatesec.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised SOW & pricing for annual attack simulation

Ethan,

Thanks — quick clarifications before I loop procurement:
1) Evidence transfer: prefer presigned S3 with client-side encrypted tarball (AES-256). Can you confirm retention window and whether you'll rotate keys?
2) Timeline: can you confirm a firm kickoff date and estimated test window (we need to avoid the Oct payroll freeze window)?
3) Redaction: we require a redacted executive report for execs + a secure full report for our SecOps team; include redaction checklist in the SOW appendix if possible.

If you can answer these I’ll forward to Acme procurement and copy in Sarah when ready. Also include a suggested PO number format we should expect (Acme typically issues PO-####).

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Ward <ethan.ward@redgatesec.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised SOW & pricing for annual attack simulation

Hi Karthik — answers inline: 

1) Evidence transfer: We will provide presigned S3 URLs to a dedicated bucket (s3://redwood-evidence-transfer/acme-2026/) and deliver a client-side encrypted tar.gz (AES-256). Keys are rotated per-engagement; object retention is 90 days by default and can be extended on request. We will not store unencrypted artifacts.

2) Timeline: Proposed kickoff 2026-09-07, on-site reconnaissance window 2026-09-13–2026-09-17 (if Acme wants an on-site day). Final delivery within 14 business days after testing. We can avoid the payroll freeze by moving active testing to week of Sept 20 if that helps.

3) Redaction: We will add a redaction appendix to the SOW (see redaction_requirements.docx) and provide a redacted executive PDF on the same day as exec debrief; the full report will be delivered under encrypted link and only shared with named SecOps recipients.

PO handling: We accept PO references in the DocuSign envelope; Acme's PO format (PO-7702) is fine. We can issue invoice upon signature and accept net 30.

If that all works I’ll generate the DocuSign route (we can have a signature path for the Acme legal contact and an internal signatory).

Regards,
Ethan
[attachment: redaction_requirements.docx (docx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Ward <ethan.ward@redgatesec.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised SOW & pricing for annual attack simulation

Ethan — that works. Two small asks before we sign: 
- Add explicit statement that evidence access logs will be provided to Acme (S3 access logs + MD5 checksums) for audit.
- Add a quick language piece: no raw PII to be included in the executive summary; any customer PII must be redacted or tokenized.

Laura / Dev — can you confirm the named SecOps recipients? I propose: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, and sec_ops_lead@acmehealth.org (we'll ask Acme to confirm).

If that's fine I told Ethan to send DocuSign and include PO-7702 as the reference.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ethan Ward <ethan.ward@redgatesec.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-16T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised SOW & pricing for annual attack simulation

Karthik / Ethan — confirmed from our side. We approve the approach with the two additions Karthik listed (S3 access logs + executive redaction language). Please route DocuSign to Acme's procurement and copy our finance (finance@redwood.ai) for PO processing.

Ethan — please also include your SOC2 cert reference (we'll need it for Acme procurement checklist) and any proof of cyber insurance limits. Once DocuSign is in, finance will raise PO-7702 and issue payment terms.

I'll review the final SOW appendix and sign after procurement confirms the PO.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[attachment: SOC2_reference.pdf (pdf) - vendor to attach]
